objective: Introduce validated TypeScript domain contracts for reusable River CRM acquisition attribution, contact consent, append-oriented relationship events, and insurance-specific lead profile data while preserving the existing River CRM relationship as canonical identity and without adding persistence, public routes, UI, telephony, or production mutations.

architecture.relationshipOwnership: Existing River CRM remains canonical for people, relationship kind, and pipeline stage.
architecture.sharedGrowthBoundary: Acquisition attribution, contact consent, and relationship event contracts belong to reusable River CRM infrastructure.
architecture.insuranceBoundary: Insurance lead profile contracts live behind an explicit insurance module and reference a canonical River CRM relationship ID.
architecture.persistenceBoundary: No D1 schema or repository implementation is part of INS-001A.

rules: relationshipId must use the existing relationship: identity boundary.
source must be normalized non-empty text.
optional text fields are normalized when present and omitted when blank.
capturedAt and updatedAt must be valid timestamps.
updatedAt must not be earlier than capturedAt.
Consent state is channel-specific.
A revoked status requires revokedAt.
A non-revoked status must not carry revokedAt.
doNotContact is an explicit suppression flag and is not inferred solely from status.
All timestamps must be valid.
updatedAt must not precede createdAt.
revokedAt must not precede capturedAt.
Events are modeled as immutable value records.
metadata must be JSON-compatible data.
event source must be normalized non-empty text.
occurredAt must be a valid timestamp.
Provider-specific IDs belong in externalReference rather than canonical identity.

insuranceContract.relationshipRule: Every insurance lead profile references one canonical River CRM relationship ID and does not duplicate name, phone, email, relationship kind, or generic CRM pipeline stage.
rules: state is normalized to a two-letter uppercase US state code.
postalCode accepts a five-digit ZIP or ZIP+4 representation.
productInterest must be one of the approved initial values.
quoteStatus must be one of the approved initial values.
assignedProducer is normalized optional text.
updatedAt must not precede createdAt.
No SSN, driver-license number, payment data, policy details, carrier credentials, or underwriting answers belong in this contract.

testRequirements: Accept a valid acquisition attribution record.
Accept explicit suppression independently from consent status.
Accept a valid CRM relationship event.
Accept valid insurance product and quote states.
Preserve canonical relationship identity without duplicating generic CRM contact fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared acquisition, consent, and event contracts compile independently of insurance-specific code.
InsuranceLeadProfile references canonical River CRM relationship identity.
Existing River CRM contracts remain backward compatible.
No Sesh source or contract is modified.
No persistence or migration file is added in INS-001A.
All validation behavior is covered by focused tests.
npm test or the narrow equivalent used for these files passes.
npm run typecheck passes before commit.
Working tree scope is limited to INS-001A planned files and its specification.
